Format Case and Vaccination Parameters for Model Input (Including Pre-1980)

Source: R/prepare_vaccination_data.R
case_vaccine_to_param.Rd

Wrapper function that prepares all time-varying parameters for use in an age-, vaccine-, and risk-structured infectious disease model, including extrapolated vaccination coverage prior to 1980 if available.

Usage

case_vaccine_to_param(
  demog_data,
  processed_vaccination,
  processed_vaccination_sia,
  processed_case,
  vaccination_schedule,
  vaccination_pre1980,
  vaccine_parameters,
  disease_parameters,
  custom_routine_vaccination = NA,
  custom_sia_vaccination = NA,
  disease = NULL,
  R0 = 1,
  processed_case_reports = processed_case,
  transmission_history = "circulating_years",
  circulation_threshold = 2,
  reporting_fraction = 1,
  seed_floor = 10,
  coverage_accuracy = 1,
  vaccine_waning = "default",
  boosters = NULL,
  booster_since = 1980
)

Arguments

demog_data

Output list from `process_demography()`.

processed_vaccination

Data frame of routine vaccine coverage.

processed_vaccination_sia

Data frame of SIA coverage.

processed_case

WHO case reports processed for the country of interest (years with cases).

vaccination_schedule

Full WHO vaccine schedule data frame.

vaccination_pre1980

Data frame of historical vaccination introduction assumptions.

vaccine_parameters

Data frame of vaccination parameters.

disease_parameters

Data frame of disease parameters.

custom_routine_vaccination

Data frame or NA indicating custom routine vaccination.

custom_sia_vaccination

Data frame or NA indicating custom sia vaccination.

disease

Disease name. If `NULL` it is taken from the case data.

R0

Basic reproduction number while transmission is on.

processed_case_reports

WHO case reports including years with zero cases. Defaults to `processed_case`.

transmission_history, circulation_threshold, reporting_fraction, seed_floor

Passed to [build_transmission_history()].

coverage_accuracy

Multiplier on the odds of vaccination (see [coverage_to_daily_rate()]).

vaccine_waning

Passed to [resolve_vaccine_waning()].

boosters

DTP booster doses from [dtp_booster_schedule()], or `NULL`. They are doses 4 onwards, given at their scheduled age, with coverage filled in before 2018 by [backfill_booster_coverage()].

booster_since

Passed to [backfill_booster_coverage()].

Value

A named list of parameters including the routine coverage and dose ages, SIA coverage, protection and waning by stratum, the time-varying R0 and the seeding inputs.
